editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Board of Pharmacy Specialties BCCCP certification examination by reviewing the official domains, question counts, and testing details.
editorial.overview: The BCCCP Board Certified Critical Care Pharmacist examination is officially administered by the Board of Pharmacy Specialties. It covers critical care, therapeutics and patient management, and professional practice across exactly 150 questions during a 225-minute testing window for qualified candidates seeking professional recognition and validating advanced clinical expertise in the field.
editorial.who_should_take: Licensed pharmacists specializing in critical care who seek professional certification through the Board of Pharmacy Specialties to demonstrate advanced expertise in patient management, clinical practice, and specialized therapeutic interventions within acute care settings.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the domains of critical care, therapeutics and patient management, and professional practice as outlined by the Board of Pharmacy Specialties. Focus your study on clinical guidelines and medication management strategies for acute care environments. Pace yourself carefully to answer all 150 questions within the 225-minute time limit to ensure you complete the assessment.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers critical care topics, accounting for exactly 23.0 percent of the total exam content and focusing on fundamental principles and acute patient stabilization within institutional practice settings for pharmacists.

This core domain covers therapeutics and patient management in depth, making up exactly 57.0 percent of the total content and emphasizing advanced patient management strategies and therapeutic drug monitoring protocols for practitioners.

This domain addresses professional practice, comprising exactly 20.0 percent of the exam and focusing on crucial professional standards, practice ethics, and established clinical practice guidelines used by certified practitioners in the field.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively across the 225-minute duration to successfully complete all 150 questions. Read each question carefully and apply sound clinical judgment during the test to ensure accuracy.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination contains a total of exactly 150 questions distributed across three specific content domains to evaluate your detailed knowledge and clinical competency for professional certification purposes.

Please check directly with the Board of Pharmacy Specialties for detailed official information regarding passing score requirements and the specific scoring methodology used for this professional certification exam.
The certification examination has a total duration of exactly 225 minutes, providing candidates sufficient time to read and answer all questions thoughtfully during the official testing session.

The board certification credential is officially administered and managed by the Board of Pharmacy Specialties for qualified and experienced licensed pharmacists seeking career advancement and professional recognition.

methodology.summary: This thorough preparation page was built using official documentation and examination guidelines provided directly by the Board of Pharmacy Specialties for candidates seeking to earn their professional certification.
